items.title: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity
items.en_title: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity
items.en_oneliner: Google Antigravity gains Mass Spec Skills, helping scientists read tandem mass spectra and work out molecular structures from the data.

items.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.en_title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.en_oneliner: GPT-6 can design protein structures and sequences through reasoning and code alone, with lab tests showing signs of binding across five targets.

items.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
items.en_title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
items.en_oneliner: With Codex and Astra, two amateur astronomers combed public Kepler and TESS data from NASA for possible exoplanets.

items.title: v2.73.0 (2026-11-23)
items.en_oneliner: Version 2.73.0 warns developers if they call a model that Anthropic or OpenAI has phased out, and refines how cached inputs are handled for OpenAI Responses.

items.title: Release v0.71.1
items.en_title: Release v0.71.1
items.en_oneliner: A patch release that backports a fix into the v0.71.0 line to address an issue in that version.

items.title: v0.26.0
items.en_oneliner: Agents SDK 0.26.0 brings the GPT-Live demo up to version 1.1 and fixes version compatibility in the external provider example plus a Docker resource limit.

items.title: Release v0.71.0
items.en_title: Release v0.71.0
items.en_oneliner: Gemini CLI ships v0.71.0 with its latest round of updates and improvements.

items.title: v2.72.0 (2026-11-23)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 2.72.0 flags requests aimed at models Anthropic or OpenAI have already retired, and adds agent instruction overrides, realtime voice instructions, and aliased tool arguments.

items.title: Release v0.72.0-preview.0
items.en_title: Release v0.72.0-preview.0
items.en_oneliner: Gemini CLI ships v0.72.0-preview.0, fixing nested .gitignore handling and Windows home paths, resuming the most recently active session, and adding authentication and input checks to the A2A server.
Thread links in search results and transcripts now reopen saved chats and nested agents, and Tab completes slash-command arguments.

items.title: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
items.en_title: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
items.en_oneliner: Clay wires Codex and ChatGPT into the sales process so teams can dig into prospects and convert raw data into outreach plans, leaning on GPT-6 models for the heavy reasoning.

items.title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
items.en_title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
items.en_oneliner: At Intentful, Marina Petrova lets agent Aria research websites and draft proposals, while it proactively flags messages and resolves issues, freeing time for growth.
Claude Code 2.1.331 extends Code Mode to terminal sessions across four cloud platforms — Bedrock, Google Cloud, Foundry, and Claude on AWS — while the apps gateway gains a new OIDC group setting.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.en_title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI and Cisco launch Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that helps teams keep running systems protected while patches roll out.

items.en_oneliner: Enterprise Frontier Safeguards now offers a zero-data-retention beta, so prompts and outputs are no longer stored.

items.en_title: Your agents run for days: now Kiro CLI keeps up

items.en_title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
items.en_oneliner: AllenAI releases the RoboTrack benchmark and 15 million simulated point tracks, plus two point-tracking models that help robots keep following target points during grasping, pipetting, and other manipulation tasks.
